title: House
description: A configured house: rooms, each of a type, with its slots bound or left empty. The whole point of the product is that this is the only thing a user writes, and even this is largely generated from what they plug in.

house_scope.description: Slots that belong to the house rather than a room, so a house-scoped behaviour is not forced through a room type it has nothing to do with.

slots.description: Slot names made available at house scope.

type.description: The name of a room type. Resolved against room_types.yaml.

bindings.description: Slot name to binding. A slot the type provides may be absent, which is how an optional slot is left unbound.

registry_id.description: The device registry id, when the binding is a device rather than a bare entity.
